messages:
alex: quick roll call — aiming to cut v1.12.0 today at 15:00 PT. can we get confirmations on: version bump PR, changelog entry, QA smoke owner? @priya @sam
priya: i'm on the bump PR (#4823). i'll update the changelog after tests pass. :white_check_mark:
sam: can do smoke testing. ETA 14:10 PT if CI green. ping me when branch is frozen.
tara: docs check — i'll skim the upgrade notes, expecting small API note. will add link to changelog.
jordan: security flagged one deps advisory earlier — i opened a hotfix PR but it's behind a failing test. will try to unblock now.
alex: thanks. bump command for release team if helpful:
```bash
git checkout release/v1.12
npm version 1.12.0 -m "chore(release): v%s"
git push --follow-tags origin release/v1.12
```
natalie: code owner approvals needed for platform changes — @jordan, can you request review from @maria-platform? or i can reassign.
jordan: pinged maria-platform. also note: the hotfix touches kv-cache module but shouldn't affect runtime.
deploy-bot: automated check: branch release/v1.12 has 3 failing CI jobs — junit flake on e2e-redis, lint warning. See: https://ci.example/3721
sam: re: failing CI — i'll re-run the flaky job now.
priya: changelog draft pushed to #4824 — short list: version bump, docs link, security advisory 0.1. Will add migration note for kv cache.
security: quick note — need a brief entry in security changelog about the deps advisory, and confirm no key material changes. can someone paste the diff? @jordan
jordan: diff: `deps: bump crate-crypto 2.3.1 -> 2.3.2` no key rotation. I'll paste full PR link: https://git.example/pr/4830
natalie: approvals: i've added my review, left one minor nits. platform owner is queued.
alex: timeline: branch freeze 14:30 PT, cut at 15:00 PT. if any blockers after 14:30 we delay by +30m. canary will be us-east-1 small pool then expand if healthy.
sam: smoke plan: run basic text-gen, embedding, and a couple rerank flows. will post results here.
priya: once CI green i'll merge bump + changelog, then assign QA. @sam i assume you want a draft checklist?
sam: yes please. tiny checklist:
- merge bump + changelog
- deploy to canary pool (us-east-1)
- run smoke script: `scripts/smoke_release.sh v1.12`
- check latency & token rate < target
- rollback if errors > 5% or latency spike >2x
priya: added checklist to PR description.
jordan: hotfix tests passing now, CI green. will re-request final review.
natalie: platform acked. maria-platform approved.
alex: anyone object to cutting at 15:00? silence will be taken as go.
priya: go from me. :rocket:
sam: go — starting smoke at 15:05 PT after deploy.
security: final: ensure audit log retention entry set to 90 days for this deploy. will verify post-cutover.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/v1.12 -> canary us-east-1 small (owner alex). webhook: https://deploys.example/989
alex: merging now.
priya: merged. changelog link: https://git.example/changelog/v1.12
sam: canary deploy started, running smoke...
sam: smoke results: text-gen ok, embeddings ok, rerank 1 failure (timeout). investigating. latency nominal.
jordan: rerank timeout traced to model-quant fallback, increased batch size. pushing patch.
sam: rerun smoke after patch.
sam: smoke all green. promoting to wider canary in 10m.
priya: tagging release notes and sending short announcement pings.
alex: nice work everyone. post-mortem: none. if any late regressions open a ticket and ping #incidents. :tada:
